title: Floating Point Numbers - Computerphile
summary: Tom Scott explains for Computerphile how floating point numbers work, why moving the binary point is fast, and why it handles money badly.
why: Recommended as a simple, fun explanation of why floating point gives odd errors like 0.1 + 0.2.

quote.text: Tom Scott's fun and simple take on Floating Points is a good video explaining why such weird errors happen
